referenceSources.description:
A Speed Yellow Porsche 968 Turbo RS is captured from behind, highlighting its signature rear wing, "turbo RS" script, and embossed Porsche logo. The wide taillights flank the smooth, aerodynamic bumper, while the single exhaust and roll cage bars peek through the rear hatch, emphasizing its track‑ready build.

Parked on a gravel turnout beside a winding mountain road, the car’s vibrant color contrasts with the muted landscape. The low stance, racing modifications, and visible fuel cell components underscore its rare status as one of only a handful of front‑engined RS models ever produced.
